FN-761KVE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 164
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Andy Whitt
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/03/2023
House Bill 164 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State Department of
Education and the local boards of education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
cost to implement a financial literacy course as a requirement for high school graduation,
beginning with ninth grade students in the 2024-2025 school year.
